messages:
Maya: Morning — quick async standup. Saw a spike in nightly embedding jobs for a customer playground. Need a short headroom bump in AMS1: +4 GPUs for ~2h to finish backlog, then scale down. Filing ticket INF-2746.
Alex: can you paste the ticket and the time window?
Maya: INF-2746 — window 09:15–11:30 UTC. It's non-blocking but will reduce queue latency.
Jordan: fine with the bump if we can keep it on the spot pool and run a small canary. Any risk to Dedicated tenants?
Maya: No Dedicated impact — routed to spot/tilt lane. Canary: warm up 2 nodes first, run smoke requests, then add the other 2.
Priya: pinging cloud quotas team — do we already have spare quota in AMS1?
infra-bot: current snapshot: GPUs allocated 42 / quota 48 in region ams1; free 6. Spot pool has preemptible nodes, eviction rate last 24h: 2.1%. Suggested safe bump: 4 GPUs for short window.
Alex: ok. What's the prewarm command?
Maya: run the ops helper: ```./ops/prewarm --region ams1 --count 4 --duration 2h --canary 2```
Jordan: add the model-warmup script from PR #842 so cache priming reduces cold-token latency. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/842
Maya: thanks — included that PR in the ticket.
Alex: small nit — ensure autoscaler min doesn't drop below our target when we scale down. Which policy are we using?
Maya: tilt-policy v2 (short-burst) with cooldown 10m; will run manual scale-down after 2h to avoid flapping.
Priya: reviewing INF-2746 now. Quick ask: can you add the list of customer IDs being processed? Need for audit.
Maya: adding customer IDs to the ticket now (redacted list). Also leaving the prewarm logs in the ticket.
Jordan: I'm leaving a quick checklist in the ticket: 1) quota verify, 2) canary warmup, 3) smoke tests (/health + small gen), 4) scale full, 5) monitor latency & errors.
Maya: perfect. Blocking items: waiting on 1) infra-bot quota confirmation (done), 2) Priya review (pending), 3) CR fix for drain race (low).
Priya: I'm on the review, found one race in drain handler — left comment on the PR. If fixed, +1.
Maya: noted, will push patch in ~15m and then kick prewarm.
Alex: I'll stand by to approve ticket permission once PR is green.
infra-bot: perf snapshot (last 2h): median token latency ams1: 38ms, p95: 210ms. Embedding backlog currently 1.2k jobs, expected to clear in ~90min with +4 gpus.
Maya: thanks infra-bot. I'll update ticket with expected clear time and start prewarm after PR merge. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
Priya: one more thing — leave the canary metrics in #metrics so SRE can eyeball.
Maya: will do, posting a short dashboard link in the ticket once live.
